evidence_snippets: Supported operating systems The Cloud Workstations plugin supports the following operating systems: Windows macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) Linux Supported versions The Cloud Workstations plugin supports the latest version, and one previous version, of JetBrains IDEs and JetBrains Gateway .

The Cloud Workstations plugin lets you initiate remote development sessions for Cloud Workstations using JetBrains IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm Professional, Rider, CLion, PhpStorm, and WebStorm.
